strategy.summary: Send the ball between adjacent red bumpers and nudge for more contacts. Complete either color set during one ball for end-of-game bonus.

quickInfo.name: Two color sets
quickInfo.summary: Gigi has one seven-bumper red set and one seven-bumper yellow set.

quickInfo.name: Single-ball sets
quickInfo.summary: A color set must reach all seven bumpers during one ball because the bumper lamps reset each ball.

quickInfo.name: End-of-game bonus
quickInfo.summary: One completed set gives 100, two give 200, and three or more give 300 at game end.

quickInfo.name: Red threads
quickInfo.summary: The primary repeat shots pass between adjacent red bumpers from 2-3 through 5-6.

quickInfo.name: Drain values
quickInfo.summary: Each outlane scores 100, while the center drain scores no points.

steps.text: Plunge to graze the top of yellow bumper 4.
Guide the falling ball toward yellow bumper 3 or 5.
Read both color sets before the ball reaches a flipper.
Shoot between adjacent red bumpers from 2-3 through 5-6.
Nudge while the ball is among the bumpers to extend the current color set.
Repeat the red-bumper threads until one color set reaches all seven.
When the ball reaches the top, accept natural hits on the two upper standup targets.
Ignore the five green rollovers and continue the bumper route.

fallback.title: Scoring side drain
fallback.when: Use this plan only when a drain is unavoidable and the ball can still reach either outlane.

steps.text: Stop flipping when another stroke would direct the ball toward the center drain.
Use one small nudge toward the nearer outlane.
Let the outlane score 100 instead of accepting a zero-point center drain.
On the next ball, restart a complete color set because all bumper lamps reset.

alternatives.title: Upper standup pass
alternatives.when: Use this plan when bumper action already sends the ball above the yellow 2 or 6 bumper.

steps.text: Track the ball while it remains above the yellow bumpers.
Nudge toward the nearby upper standup target.
Do not replace an open bumper thread with a forced standup shot.
Resume bumper threads when the ball returns to the lower flippers.
Complete all seven bumpers of either color during one ball.
On a later ball, complete another full color set.
Complete a third full color set before the game ends.
Protect each ball because six lit bumpers give no set credit.

techniques.name: Yellow 4 skill shot
techniques.instruction: Plunge to graze the top of yellow bumper 4. Guide the rebound toward yellow bumper 3 or 5.

techniques.name: Red-bumper thread
techniques.instruction: Aim between two adjacent red bumpers. Let the falling ball contact their sides instead of hitting one bumper face first.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use small nudges while the ball moves among the bumpers. Guide it toward an unlit bumper in the chosen color set.

cautions.issue: A face-on bumper hit can send the ball directly down the center.
cautions.response: Thread the ball between bumper pairs. Prefer contacts while the ball moves down through the bumper field.

cautions.issue: Feeds from the bumpers and side lanes can reach a drain or the slingshots without control.
cautions.response: Track each exit and nudge before the ball reaches a slingshot. Do not assume a side-lane feed is safe.

cautions.issue: Six lit bumpers in a color set give no end-of-game bonus if the ball drains.
cautions.response: Prioritize the last missing bumper. Avoid unrelated rollovers and standups until that bumper scores.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Gigi and tournament treatment of replay awards.
Test red-bumper threading, yellow lanes, side returns, and bumper-area nudges.
strategy.simpleOverview: Gigi counts one complete seven-bumper red set or yellow set toward its end-of-game bonus, but partial sets reset at the start of each ball. Thread the ball between adjacent bumpers, nudge for missing contacts, and finish one color before the ball drains.
strategy.overview: Gigi turns complete seven-bumper color sets into an end-of-game bonus, but partial sets reset every ball. Use repeatable threads between adjacent red bumpers and controlled nudges to finish one color in a single ball. Complete full sets on later balls until the game-end award reaches its three-set maximum.
machineSetup: Confirm Gottlieb Gigi and tournament treatment of replay awards.
